integrity.computational_status: finite standard-library verification only; the infinite statement is proved by recurrence induction and elementary group theory
integrity.novelty_qualification: 2010 derangement-polynomial recurrence and prior subfactorial modular upper bounds are acknowledged as known

limitations: Parameters must satisfy m >= 2 and gcd(u,m) = 1; the nonunit case is excluded.
The exact period applies to evaluations of weighted derangement polynomials, not coefficientwise congruence of symbolic polynomials.
No uniform distribution of sequence values, nor a classification of other permutation statistics, is claimed.
Equivalent coverage in broader or unlocated mathematical literature remains a genuine originality risk.
title: Exact modular periods and period spectra of weighted derangement polynomials
